{{Quote|Contact the ''War Hammer''. Tell Moff Yage that, on behalf of the true Emperor, I welcome him back.|Treis Sinde issues a command to the brown-haired Imperial Knight|<ref name="Legacy War 4" />}}
A '''Human female''' with [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair was an [[Imperial Knight]] in [[138 ABY]]. During the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple]], she served under Master [[Treis Sinde]] aboard a [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]]
